hookLine: Ranking the funniest kids moments from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: Falling asleep mid-meal, watermelon still in hand.
Number 4: Sticking your tongue out at the camera like a total menace.
Number 3: Drawing all over yourself and blaming absolutely nobody.
Number 2: Refusing to smile for a single family photo.
Number 1: Finding the hidden chocolate stash and going full zombie mode!
